name: users
definition: 在问答社区中注册并拥有账户、可发布内容与参与投票的自然人。 Counterexample: 与「账户」辨析：账户是登录凭据集合，用户是社区中的行为主体；与「访客」辨析：访客无注册身份。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table users; provenance: direct source users

name: badges
definition: 平台依据用户行为授予的荣誉标识记录，含名称与授予时间。 Counterexample: 与「用户」辨析：徽章是授予记录而非人；与「标签」辨析：标签用于内容分类，徽章用于用户荣誉。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table badges; provenance: direct source badges

name: comments
definition: 用户针对某篇帖子发表的文字反馈记录，含评分与创建时间。 Counterexample: 与「帖子」辨析：评论依附于帖子且篇幅短、非独立主题；与「投票」辨析：投票只表达倾向，评论含文字内容。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table comments; provenance: direct source comments

name: postHistory
definition: 记录帖子每次修订或状态变更的版本化信息条目，含变更类型与修订标识。 Counterexample: 与「帖子」辨析：帖子是当前内容，帖子历史是历次变更的留痕；与「评论」辨析：评论面向读者，历史面向编辑过程。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table postHistory; provenance: direct source postHistory

name: postLinks
definition: 记录两篇帖子之间关联关系的信息条目，含关联类型与建立时间。 Counterexample: 与「帖子」辨析：帖子是内容主体，帖子链接是帖子之间的关联记录；与「标签」辨析：标签是分类，链接是帖间指向。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table postLinks; provenance: direct source postLinks

name: posts
definition: 用户在问答社区发布的问答内容条目，含标题、正文与统计计数。 Counterexample: 与「评论」辨析：帖子是独立主题内容，评论是对帖子的回应；与「帖子历史」辨析：帖子是当前版本，历史是变更留痕。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table posts; provenance: direct source posts

name: tags
definition: 用于对帖子主题进行分类的关键词条目，含名称与使用计数。 Counterexample: 与「徽章」辨析：标签用于内容分类，徽章用于用户荣誉；与「帖子链接」辨析：标签是分类维度，链接是帖间指向。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tags; provenance: direct source tags

name: votes
definition: 用户对帖子表达赞成或反对等倾向的记录，含投票类型与时间。 Counterexample: 与「评论」辨析：投票只表达倾向无文字，评论含文字内容；与「徽章」辨析：投票是行为记录，徽章是荣誉授予。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table votes; provenance: direct source votes

name: User
definition: A registered account on the site, identified by Id and shown by DisplayName.

name: UserDisplayName
definition: The public display name of a user.

name: UserReputation
definition: The reputation score of a user.

name: UserUpVotes
definition: The number of up votes a user has cast.

name: UserDownVotes
definition: The number of down votes a user has cast.

name: UserAge
definition: The age of a user.

name: UserCreationDate
definition: The date a user account was created.

name: UserLastAccessDate
definition: The last date a user accessed the website.

name: UserViews
definition: The number of views on a user's profile.

name: Post
definition: A post on the site, which can be a question, answer, or other post type.

name: PostTitle
definition: The title of a post.

name: PostBody
definition: The body content of a post.

name: PostScore
definition: The score of a post.

name: PostViewCount
definition: The number of views a post has received.

name: PostCreationDate
definition: The date a post was created.

name: PostAnswerCount
definition: The number of answers a post has.

name: PostCommentCount
definition: The number of comments a post has.

name: PostFavoriteCount
definition: The number of times a post has been favorited.

name: PostOwnerUserId
definition: The user who owns a post.

name: PostLastEditorUserId
definition: The user who last edited a post.

name: PostTags
definition: The tags associated with a post.

name: Comment
definition: A comment on a post.

name: CommentText
definition: The text content of a comment.

name: CommentScore
definition: The score of a comment.

name: CommentCreationDate
definition: The date a comment was created.

name: CommentUserId
definition: The user who made a comment.

name: Badge
definition: A badge awarded to a user.

name: BadgeName
definition: The name/type of a badge.

name: BadgeDate
definition: The date a badge was awarded.

name: BadgeUserId
definition: The user who received a badge.

name: Vote
definition: A vote cast on a post.

name: VoteTypeId
definition: The type of a vote.

name: VoteCreationDate
definition: The date a vote was cast.

name: VoteUserId
definition: The user who cast a vote.

name: VoteBountyAmount
definition: The bounty amount associated with a vote.

name: PostLink
definition: A link between two posts.

name: PostLinkCreationDate
definition: The date a post link was created.

name: PostLinkTypeId
definition: The type of a post link.

name: Tag
definition: A tag used to categorize posts.

name: TagName
definition: The name of a tag.

name: TagCount
definition: The number of posts associated with a tag.

name: TagExcerptPostId
definition: The post from which a tag excerpt is taken.

name: TagWikiPostId
definition: The wiki post associated with a tag.

name: PostHistory
definition: A historical record of changes to a post.

name: PostHistoryTypeId
definition: The type of a post history record.

name: PostHistoryCreationDate
definition: The date a post history record was created.

name: PostHistoryUserId
definition: The user who made a post history record.

name: PostHistoryText
definition: The text content of a post history record.

name: PostHistoryComment
definition: The comment associated with a post history record.

name: PostsPerVote
definition: The ratio of a user's posts to their votes. Formula: Post / Vote. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; Vote = votes.Id

name: AverageUpVotes
definition: The average number of up votes per user. Formula: UserUpVotes / User. Inputs: UserUpVotes = users.UpVotes; User = users.Id

name: AverageUserAge
definition: The average age of users. Formula: UserAge / User. Inputs: UserAge = users.Age; User = users.Id

name: AverageViewCount
definition: The average number of views per post. Formula: PostViewCount / Post. Inputs: PostViewCount = posts.ViewCount; Post = posts.Id

name: MonthlyLinkCount
definition: The average number of links created per month. Formula: PostLink / 12. Inputs: PostLink = postLinks.Id

name: PercentageDifferenceBadges
definition: The percentage difference between badge counts in two periods. Formula: (Badge_2011 - Badge_2010) / Badge_2010. Inputs: Badge = badges.Id; BadgeDate = badges.Date

name: PostsWithMoreThan10
definition: Users who have created more than 10 posts. Formula: Post > 10. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostOwnerUserId = posts.OwnerUserId

name: PostsWithNoComments
definition: Posts that have zero comments. Formula: PostCommentCount = 0. Inputs: PostCommentCount = posts.CommentCount

name: PostsWithOneComment
definition: Posts that have exactly one comment. Formula: PostCommentCount = 1. Inputs: PostCommentCount = posts.CommentCount

name: PostsWithViews100To150
definition: Posts with view counts between 100 and 150. Formula: PostViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150. Inputs: PostViewCount = posts.ViewCount

name: MostValuablePost2010
definition: The post with the highest favorite count in 2010. Formula: MAX(PostFavoriteCount) WHERE YEAR(PostCreationDate) = 2010. Inputs: PostFavoriteCount = posts.FavoriteCount; PostCreationDate = posts.CreaionDate

name: MostViewedPost
definition: The post with the highest view count. Formula: MAX(PostViewCount). Inputs: PostViewCount = posts.ViewCount

name: HighestScoredComment
definition: The comment with the highest score. Formula: MAX(CommentScore). Inputs: CommentScore = comments.Score

name: UsersAccessedAfter2014
definition: Users who last accessed the site after 2014-09-01. Formula: UserLastAccessDate > '2014-09-01'. Inputs: UserLastAccessDate = users.LastAccessDate

name: AccountsCreated2011
definition: Users whose accounts were created in 2011. Formula: YEAR(UserCreationDate) = 2011. Inputs: UserCreationDate = users.CreationDate

name: PostType
definition: Classifies posts by their type (question, answer, etc.).

name: VoteType
definition: Classifies votes by their type (upvote, downvote, etc.).

name: PostHistoryType
definition: Classifies post history records by their type (edit, close, etc.).

name: LinkType
definition: Classifies post links by their type (duplicate, related, etc.).

name: BadgeType
definition: Classifies badges by their name/type.
